tracks.announcement_text: in Japan, onmyōdō developed from calendrical learning, yin and yang cosmology, and divination within imperial institutions. its specialists had a place in the ordering of public life, and their authority changed over the centuries. there is a rather different kind of calendrical responsibility in Ponyville. the town brings in spring without unicorn spells, with teams attending to the weather, plants, and animals. Twilight arrives expecting to find a task for her magic, and ends up earning a vest for coordinating all three teams.
tracks.title: arcana: the calendar and the season

tracks.announcement_text: European vernacular traditions preserve blessings, weather lore, and customs associated with the agricultural year. some were handed down through households rather than learned from an elaborate book of ritual. i wonder how much of the history of a place could fit into an ordinary day’s work. at Sweet Apple Acres, the howling of the timberwolves announces the coming of the zap apples. Granny Smith’s unusual harvest preparations embarrass Apple Bloom until she hears how her family discovered the apples and helped establish Ponyville.
tracks.title: arcana: the old harvest customs

tracks.announcement_text: the magical handbooks from Roman-period Egypt and later centuries contain writings in Greek, Demotic, and Coptic. researchers study how those books were assembled and transmitted, including their very different formulas for protection, divination, and other rites. opening an old magical book can be quite a moment. Spike found one in the Castle of the Two Sisters that promised to give physical form to imagined things. Rarity’s first experiment was to beautify the spellbook itself. by the time she was redesigning Ponyville, i rather wished he had listened to the owl.
tracks.title: arcana: a book with many voices

tracks.announcement_text: when studying an omen involving a crow, our Arcana research suggests keeping the observation separate from its interpretation. write down where the bird is, what it is doing, and what is happening around it before consulting a particular tradition. even a very attentive observer can misunderstand a bird. Fluttershy once found Princess Celestia’s pet looking terribly ill and tried everything she could think of to help. Philomena was a phoenix preparing to renew herself. i imagine that was one very memorable addition to Fluttershy’s knowledge of birds.
tracks.title: arcana: a note beside the bird

tracks.announcement_text: an old ritual object can have a history of ownership, obligations, and permissions that is not apparent from its appearance. a public description of a sacred place or practice does not necessarily make it available for everyone to enter or use. i thought of Fluttershy when she finally asked Ahuizotl why he kept pursuing Daring Do. he was responsible for protecting the jungle’s artifacts. every missing relic was a problem for him. for once, the adventurers had to hear the story from the creature looking after the place.
tracks.title: arcana: the guardian of the relics

tracks.announcement_text: the Rosicrucian manifestos appeared in the early seventeenth century. the first, published in sixteen fourteen, described a brotherhood devoted to learning and spiritual renewal. the writings inspired real movements, although the existence of the fraternity they described at the time of publication is a separate historical question. it reminds me of Pinkie Pie’s discovery in an old family record. even Goldie Delicious could not read the smudged passage that might establish Pinkie’s kinship with the Apples. some questions remain open in the archive, even after a lovely family hug.
tracks.title: arcana: the page that leaves a question

tracks.announcement_text: records of the European witch trials can tell us what a person was accused of, and how the authorities understood the accusation. they are not always reliable accounts of what the accused actually practiced. some testimony was obtained under terrible coercion. that distinction between rumor and knowledge brings Zecora to mind. the ponies feared her magic, but Apple Bloom took the trouble to speak with her. the strange afflictions came from a plant called Poison Joke, and the pony they had feared knew how to help them.
tracks.title: arcana: what an accusation records

tracks.announcement_text: at the ancient Greek sanctuary of Asclepius at Epidaurus, people seeking healing could sleep in a sacred setting, hoping for a dream or a divine encounter. inscriptions preserve accounts of cures attributed to the god. i find that relationship between dreams and waking life fascinating. on a camping trip, Princess Luna once met Scootaloo in a nightmare and helped her understand what she was really afraid of. it wasn’t the Headless Horse so much as disappointing Rainbow Dash. Luna’s advice was something Scootaloo still had to act on when she woke.
tracks.title: arcana: a place to dream

tracks.announcement_text: the Yorùbá divinatory tradition of Ifá preserves an enormous body of verses, arranged in two hundred and fifty-six divisions called odù. a trained diviner learns to interpret the signs and draw upon the verses in consultation. it is a remarkable inheritance of living knowledge, carried through generations of teachers. i remember Yona asking Rockhoof to finish the story he had begun in class. he thought his time had passed, but the students wanted to hear what he remembered. Twilight found a rather fitting occupation for him, as Equestria’s official keeper of tales.
tracks.title: arcana: the keeper of tales

tracks.announcement_text: runes were used for writing in several historical Germanic alphabets. some inscriptions on stone remember particular people, rather than offering instructions for divination. modern rune readings have histories of their own. i like thinking about an object made to carry a memory forward. when Twilight lost her library, her friends made a chandelier from the surviving roots of the Golden Oak Library. its ornaments held images of their old adventures together. imagine looking up and seeing the place you used to call home, above a table where there is room for all your friends.
tracks.title: arcana: a memory set in stone

tracks.announcement_text: in Chinese alchemical history, external alchemy, called waidan, involved working with substances such as minerals and metals in the pursuit of elixirs. it had its own cosmology and aims, but some of those substances were dangerously toxic. reading an old recipe is not the same as knowing how to work with it. i thought of Apple Bloom watching Zecora prepare a potion for a rooster that had lost its crow. she used the flower from that potion to try to obtain a cutie mark and ended up with far more marks than she had bargained for. Zecora had already told her that time was the remedy for that particular wish.
tracks.title: arcana: the promise of an elixir

tracks.announcement_text: one branch of historical astrology, called electional astrology, concerns choosing a suitable moment for an undertaking by considering celestial configurations. its practitioners were interested not only in what might happen, but in when to act. that is different from calculating when a visible astronomical event will occur. i remember Twilight planning one special moment on a family zeppelin holiday through the Frozen North. the Northern Stars would be visible at sunset, and she wanted to share them with her family. her royal duties made her miss the sight, so her family made a little version of the spectacle for her themselves.
tracks.title: arcana: a particular evening sky

tracks.announcement_text: the Renaissance scholar Marsilio Ficino wrote about music in connection with celestial influences. in his account of natural magic, song could participate in the correspondences between earthly and heavenly things. music was more than entertainment within that philosophy. and speaking of music with a particular purpose, i remember how urgently Pinkie Pie was looking for a trombone when the parasprites first appeared in Ponyville. her friends were trying to get rid of the creatures by all sorts of other means. what they needed was to listen to Pinkie, and the parasprites needed a little parade.
tracks.title: arcana: a rather particular tune

tracks.announcement_text: my silver sigil's getting a signal, friend.
tracks.title: astra · sendoff segue

tracks.announcement_text:
Our quantum harmony research reminded me of Fluttershy and the Breezies. She gives those little travelers a place to rest. You can see why they’d want to stay. You can also see the trouble before she can quite bring herself to say it. They still have a journey to make. The pony who made them feel so welcome has to be the one who asks them to go. I like that the story lets that part be hard for her.

It reminds me of waiting with a friend for their train. You wish you had another hour together.
tracks.title: Fluttershy opens the door

tracks.announcement_text: Picture a table in fifteenth-century Italy. You have a hand of tarot cards, and somebody is waiting for you to take your turn. Those cards belonged to a game. The arcana paper follows them into a very different setting centuries later. In nineteen oh nine, a deck appeared with pictures by Pamela Colman Smith, working with Arthur Edward Waite. Here’s what I like about pausing on her name. Before anyone could read those cards, somebody had to decide what we’d see.
tracks.title: The artist at the card table

tracks.announcement_text: I have a soft spot for the moment Princess Celestia sends Twilight her own letters back. Discord has made it hard for Twilight to remember why she ever trusted her friends. Imagine opening an envelope and finding your own handwriting, from a day when you knew exactly why. I think I’d recognize the little things first. A word squeezed in above the line. A sentence that starts out very dignified and ends halfway down the page because somebody made me laugh.
tracks.title: In Twilight’s own writing

tracks.announcement_text:
The arcana paper sent me looking for one verse in particular. In an old Norse poem, Odin sends two ravens over the world each day. He worries about Huginn coming back, and about Muninn even more. I had my pencil ready to write down what the birds might tell him. Then I put it down. Imagine being there when the first pair of wings comes within earshot. I think I’d be listening right past that lovely racket, waiting to hear the second bird.

I’m trying to picture the moment when you finally hear both of them. There goes the pencil again.
tracks.title: Listening for the second bird

tracks.announcement_text:
Suppose I’m in the booth and you’re across town. We each have one particle from an entangled pair. Can I use my half to tell you there’s a biscuit here with your name on it? I’d dearly like to. Your results, taken on their own, give you no way to read that message. The interesting pattern shows up when we bring our records together and compare them. We explore the mathematics in our quantum harmony research. Meanwhile I’d better find my phone.

There should be just enough light in here to get a decent picture of that biscuit.
tracks.title: The biscuit still needs a note
